name: Validate the submit button is working
fullName: Zen Portal Login and Logout: Validate the submit button is working

steps.name: Given I am on the Zen Portal login page
Navigate to the Zen Portal login page
Then the submit button should be visible and enabled
Verify the submit button is visible and enabled
When I enter invalid credentials and click sign in
Enter invalid credentials and click Sign in
Then an error message should be displayed
Verify the credential-error banner is displayed
